description: This script performs heapwalk analysis and memory monitoring for a device, including logging, process verification, memory address analysis, and data aggregation related to WiFi access points and memory maps.

methods.name: sanitize_hex
methods.description: Removes the '0x' prefix from a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: hex_to_dec
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to its decimal equivalent.

methods.name: decimal_to_hex
methods.description: Converts a decimal number to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: check_address
methods.description: Checks whether an address falls within known memory map regions and logs details accordingly.
